finding_detail: Isolated rehearsal cloned root_n8n_postgres_data_retry006 to a dedicated internal-network PostgreSQL 16.15 + n8n 2.33.3 topology with no production mutation. WF40 active-version Schedule Trigger integrity PASS (83 nodes, typeVersion 1.2, 1-minute interval). After matching production NODES_EXCLUDE=[], WF40 activated on PostgreSQL but passive 240s observation recorded 0 trigger-mode executions (baseline execution id 295045 unchanged). Exactly one native unpublish/publish cycle for WF40 completed with exit 0 and unchanged nodes/connections hashes; a second 240s observation still recorded 0 ticks. Concurrent SQLite production continued 15 WF40 trigger executions in 15 minutes. Per contract, production cutover was not attempted.
